page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c8g1.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682 v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 8 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core, paired with 32.0 GB of system memory. The instance is equipped with a single NVIDIA Pascal P4 GPU providing 8 GB of VRAM. It does not include local storage, relying on network-attached storage, and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate that the CPU and memory performance of this instance are generally modest. Single-core CPU performance via stress-ng falls in the bottom 10%, while multi-core CPU performance is in the bottom 25%. Memory bandwidth for small cached blocks is average, but large-block read and write speeds are weak, falling in the bottom 25%. Similarly, database operations, Redis SET throughput, and static web serving benchmarks are categorized as weak, reflecting the older hardware generation of the Intel Xeon E5 v4 processor.

The primary tradeoff of the ecs.gn5i-c8g1.2xlarge is its reliance on legacy CPU and GPU architectures, which limits its raw processing speed compared to modern cloud instances. However, the inclusion of a dedicated NVIDIA P4 GPU makes it a cost-efficient option for workloads requiring hardware acceleration without the high cost of newer GPU generations. This instance is suited for entry-level GPU-accelerated tasks such as small-scale machine learning inference, video transcoding, and lightweight parallel processing workloads that do not demand high CPU or memory bandwidth.
